summary: Iteration-10 backend regression: 17/17 PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration10_features.py covering tax-options (no PPN12), polis_amount/insurance_amount contract, PATCH extended, Receive auto-cost SPSI/Forklift (with replace-no-duplicate), bulk-revert-to-open, per-issuer bank settings, SettingIn Optional key_name, invoice-logo admin-only upload, Invoice Excel formatting (B5 INVOICE banner #FFFFFF/#7F7F7F, B13 'No' #595959, Indonesian dates, summary labels Jumlah/>>PPN/Sub Total/>>Asuransi/>>Polis/>>Adm/>>Materai/TOTAL, BANK ADDRESS + Mandiri default), Report-AR invoice_ids filter, Cash Advance settle awb_breakdown (3-AWB cost creation, mismatch=400, partial+refund).

minor.issue: If tax_ppn_12 was ever seeded into DB by a previous iteration, the seed function will NOT remove it (uses $setOnInsert). Currently no PPN 12 row was found in the live DB, so tax-options correctly returns only 0/1/11 — but a stale environment could surface PPN 12 again. Consider an explicit delete_one({key_name:'tax_ppn_12'}) at startup to make the migration deterministic.

action_items: (OPTIONAL) Add startup migration to drop any legacy tax_ppn_12 settings row.

(NOTE) Older regression files test_iteration3_features.py and test_iteration4_receive_exports.py now fail because they assert the OLD contract (insurance_policy, PPN12 present, received_polis, B6 banner). These are expected to fail and should be deleted or rewritten by main agent — they were superseded by test_iteration10_features.py.
critical_code_review_comments: Receive endpoint correctly side-effects to awb_costs (SPSI / Sewa Forklift) and is idempotent via delete_many({source:'receive', sub_label:name}) before insert — verified by replaying receive with new SPSI=80000 producing exactly 1 SPSI cost.

Cash Advance settle with awb_breakdown enforces sum(breakdown)==actual_amount (returns 400 on mismatch). However note: when actual_amount is provided AND breakdown total equals actual_amount BUT refund > 0, journal credits 1108 with actual+refund — that's correct accounting (release the full panjar = used + refunded). Validated.
POST /api/settings/invoice-logo correctly enforces administrator role (require_role('administrator')) — operation user correctly gets 403.

Invoice Excel _build_invoice_sheet writes B5 INVOICE banner with FFFFFF font / 7F7F7F fill and B13 'No' header with 595959 fill — matches AR Cargo screenshot spec. Indonesian date formatter is being invoked for V8 (Date) and V9 (Due Date).
PATCH /api/orders/{oid}/extended uses model_dump() and filters None — so PATCHing only polis_amount preserves other fields. Good.
